tm.consent.title: Join the test?
tm.consent.body:
Skybloom is a small playtest. If you agree, the game records how you play so the developer can improve it:
• your taps and moves (where on the game screen you touched, and what happened)
• how long each screen is open, scores, items, bubbles and the ad mock-up
• your browser, screen size and language. No name, e-mail, phone model or account ID.
The record stays on this device until you send the file yourself (Settings → Send Play Log). The developer keeps received files for 30 days. You can delete everything and stop at any time in Settings → Send Play Log.
Nothing is recorded until you agree.
tm.limit: 20 minutes are up. Thank you! You can keep playing.
